As a Reliability Engineer, you'll help take the plant from construction to stable operations. You'll oversee the installation and commissioning of cranes, conductor systems, monorails and other lifting equipment, ensuring safe, high-quality delivery. Once the plant is running, you'll improve the reliability and performance of our lifting equipment by developing maintenance strategies, solving technical challenges and driving continuous improvements.
Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.
Oversee the installation and commissioning of EOT cranes, conductor systems, monorails and other lifting equipment.
Work with contractors, OEMs and internal teams to deliver safe, high-quality installations.
Prepare maintenance plans, spare parts strategies and documentation to support a smooth handover to operations.
Investigate equipment failures, identify root causes and implement long-term improvements.
Develop preventive and predictive maintenance strategies to increase equipment reliability and reduce downtime.
Use maintenance and performance data to improve the reliability, availability and lifetime of cranes and lifting equipment.

What you’ll bring
Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below:
Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related field.
Hands-on experience installing, commissioning, maintaining or improving the reliability of cranes or industrial lifting equipment.
Experience from heavy industry, manufacturing or industrial maintenance.
Good understanding of crane systems, electrical and mechanical equipment, and relevant industry standards.
Experience with reliability methods such as RCA, FMEA and preventive or predictive maintenance, as well as CMMS/EAM systems (e.g. SAP PM, Hexagon or Maximo).
Good English communication skills. Swedish is an advantage.

jobs.occupation: GraphDB Specialist / Data Engineer  Neo4j & Knowledge Graph (Göteborg)
jobs.description:
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced GraphDB Specialist (Data Engineer) to design, develop and maintain a central Knowledge Graph data foundation for a Cybersecurity Data Collection and Correlation (CDC) Engine.
In this role, you will work with complex data structures, security-related entities and relationships, building scalable graph database solutions. You will also contribute to integrating graph data with AI and Large Language Model (LLM) pipelines using GraphRAG and vector-graph hybrid querying.
You will collaborate with technical teams to develop reliable data architecture, automate ingestion workflows and ensure secure and efficient access to graph data.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop Knowledge Graph architecture, ontology and data models.

Build and maintain graph data ingestion pipelines.

Implement GraphRAG and vector-graph hybrid querying to integrate graph data with LLM-based applications.

Develop and manage graph database solutions using Neo4j and Azure Cosmos DB (Gremlin).

Integrate data ingestion and graph update workflows into CI/CD pipelines.

Manage graph database configurations, updates and data relationships.

Ensure data quality, consistency, scalability and secure access to graph information.

Collaborate with engineering, AI and cybersecurity teams.

Required Qualifications
Strong hands-on experience with graph databases, particularly Neo4j.

Experience with Azure Cosmos DB and Gremlin API.

Strong background in data engineering and data modelling.

Experience designing and developing Knowledge Graphs and ontologies.

Experience building and maintaining data ingestion pipelines.

Knowledge of CI/CD processes and integration of data workflows into automated pipelines.

Understanding of graph querying, database architecture and data relationships.

Good communication and collaboration skills.

Professional proficiency in English.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with GraphRAG and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

Experience integrating graph databases with LLM applications.

Knowledge of vector databases and hybrid search solutions.

Experience in cybersecurity, threat intelligence or security data analytics.

Experience with cloud-based data engineering solutions.

jobs.description:
Drive Strategic Maintenance Excellence in Gothenburg
Join a large-scale industrial project as a Senior Reliability Engineer, where you will take both strategic and operational responsibility for asset structures and maintenance tactics. This hybrid contract role offers the opportunity to influence long-term reliability for critical infrastructure while collaborating with a global engineering team.
The Role and Your Impact
Reporting to the Asset Management Project Manager, you will act as the technical linchpin between our global project resources and the local Gothenburg site. Your focus will be on building a robust foundation for asset performance through structured data and proactive strategies.
Key Responsibilities
Establish and optimize technical asset hierarchies and Bill of Materials (BOM).
Define maintenance tactics utilizing RCM, FMEA, or PMO methodologies.
Ensure all maintenance strategies comply with ISO 55000 standards and local regulations.
Manage technical interfaces and present deliverables to diverse stakeholder groups.
Verify the accuracy of technical data within CMMS/EAM environments.

Professional Requirements
We are looking for a senior specialist with a B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical or Maintenance Engineering. You must have at least 5 years of experience in Reliability Engineering within large-scale industrial environments. Proficiency in English is mandatory for managing international stakeholders, alongside advanced skills in systems like SAP PM, IBM Maximo, or IFS. Deep knowledge of ISO 55000 is a prerequisite for success in this role.
Preferred Qualifications
Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP) status.
Experience working with remote international teams.
Knowledge of Spare Parts Optimization and Life Cycle Cost (LCC) analysis.

What We Offer
Senior contract position in a high-profile industrial project.
Hybrid work arrangement based in Gothenburg.
Collaboration with an international team of 5 dedicated engineers.

We are looking for a Welding Engineer to join our Applications Engineering team within R&D Filler Metals.

This position offering the opportunity to combine welding engineering expertise, hands-on technical work and project management. You will support internal and external customers by investigating technical challenges, coordinating welding trials and testing, and developing reliable and cost-effective solutions.

You will work closely with R&D development engineers, product managers, welders and laboratory specialists, making this a highly collaborative and varied role.
Lead and manage Applications Engineering projects from initial request through to final reporting.
Provide technical welding expertise and support to internal and external customers.
Plan and coordinate welding trials, testing and technical investigations.
Work closely with chemical, metallographic, mechanical and non-destructive testing laboratories.
Analyze test results and develop conclusions and recommendations.
Develop welding processes, procedures and recommendations for customer applications.
Support the application of ESAB filler metals in different customer applications.
Perform competitor comparisons and evaluate new and existing product combinations.
Read, interpret and apply relevant welding standards, regulations and test methods.
Prepare technical reports and document project findings and recommendations.
Collaborate with R&D and other internal stakeholders to deliver effective solutions.
When required, support activities directly at customer sites.
Degree in Welding Engineering, Materials Engineering or a related technical field.
Minimum BSc; MSc or PhD is an advantage.
Several years of relevant experience in welding technology and welding applications.
Proven practical experience with welding processes, equipment, materials and process parameters.
Proven experience in project management or a role involving significant ownership and coordination.
Deep knowledge of welding standards and test methods is required.
IWE qualification is required 
Fluent English, both written and spoken, is required.
Swedish is highly desirable but not mandatory.

jobs.occupation: BI Developer - Data Analytics & Business Intelligence - 20718
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
About the service
Assignment Description
We are seeking an experienced BI Developer / Data Analyst to join a Data & Analytics team working on next-generation analytical solutions using modern data platforms.
You will work in a cross-functional agile team, developing scalable data products and analytical services with a focus on data quality, consistent metrics, semantic modeling, and self-service analytics.
What You Will Work On
Develop and maintain data models using dbt and semantic models in Looker.
Create analyses, KPIs, and data-driven decision-making materials.
Develop dashboards and reports using Looker or similar tools.
Build interactive data visualizations in web applications using JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks.
Work closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into analytical solutions.
Ensure quality, consistency, and clarity in data definitions and metrics.
Collaborate with developers, project managers, UX specialists, and analysts.

What You Bring
Strong SQL and DBT experience, with the ability to independently drive analytics from requirements to delivery.
Experience with Looker, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.
Experience in data modeling and working with large datasets.
At least 5 years of relevant experience as a Data Analyst, Analytics Engineer, or similar.
Proven experience translating business needs into analytical solutions.
Fluent Swedish and English, both spoken and written.

Meritorious
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and BigQuery.
GitHub.
LookML and semantic layers.
AI-assisted development tools such as Copilot or Claude.
Data and analytics product development.
Self-service analytics and user-focused reporting.
JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks such as Vue.js.
Experience building interactive charts and data visualizations.
